evals.name: Dual POSIX Signal Handling & Readiness Invalidation
evals.prompt: Implement graceful shutdown handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT, ensuring the /health/ready endpoint returns HTTP 503 immediately while in-flight requests finish.
evals.expected_output: Registers SIGTERM and SIGINT listeners, updates readiness probe state to 503, and pauses for load balancer propagation before closing server socket.
assertions: Registers explicit event listeners for both POSIX SIGTERM and SIGINT termination signals
Invalidates internal readiness state so /health/ready returns HTTP 503 immediately
Applies a delay before closing the HTTP listener to allow load balancer route propagation
Prevents accepting new incoming network connections during the termination sequence

evals.name: Kubernetes Grace Period Budgeting & In-Flight Request Draining
evals.prompt: Configure a shutdown coordinator with an internal grace timeout of 25 seconds to guarantee safe shutdown before Kubernetes terminationGracePeriodSeconds (30s) fires SIGKILL.
evals.expected_output: Defines internal 25s timeout timer, invokes server.close() to drain in-flight requests, and forces exit 1 if timeout is exceeded.
assertions: Configures internal shutdown grace timeout strictly below orchestrator termination ceiling
Awaits completion of in-flight HTTP transactions via server.close connection draining
Sets up an automated forced-exit fallback timer in case in-flight requests hang
Emits exit code 1 if the grace period expires before connections are drained

evals.name: Ordered Infrastructure Teardown & Buffer Flushing
evals.prompt: Orchestrate resource deallocation during graceful shutdown, ensuring queue consumers pause, telemetry and logs flush, database pools close cleanly, and process exits with code 0.
evals.expected_output: Stops queue consumers, flushes OpenTelemetry and logger buffers, drains database pool and Redis, and calls process.exit(0) with uptime log.
assertions: Halts asynchronous message queue consumers before closing underlying message brokers
Flushes pending OpenTelemetry spans and structured logging buffers before terminating
Closes database connection pools and cache clients only after requests are drained
Terminates cleanly with process exit code 0 and logs total process uptime
